title: PM4Bench: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models with Parallel Multilingual Multi-modal Multi-task Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cross-lingual performance disparities by calculating the coefficient of variation ($S_{cv}$) of evaluation scores across 10 different languages on a strictly parallel multi-modal corpus, encompassing tasks like visual question answering, open-ended generation, and multi-scale OCR.
